notes.title: 🎄 Special Christmas Announcement! 🎄
notes.content:
[h1]🎄 Special Christmas Announcement! 🎄[/h1]

This holiday season, we’ve got something magical brewing just for you! 🎁

Starting on Christmas Day, we’re introducing a brand-new animated scene featuring the shopkeeper! This festive addition is filled with holiday charm and a special surprise to discover. 🎅✨

[h1]How to Access the Scene[/h1]

The new animated scene will be accessible directly from the shop screen via a new festive icon. Simply click the icon to enjoy the holiday magic!

[h1]Quality of Life Update[/h1]

We’ve added a windowed mode feature! Press F11 to switch the game to windowed mode, making it easier to adjust the screen or move it to another monitor. Enjoy more flexibility while playing!

[h1]Join Our Discord Server[/h1]

We’re excited to announce that our [url=https://discord.com/invite/C5YfJp7dXc]official Discord server[/url] is now live! 🎉 Here, you’ll find the latest news about our games, exclusive announcements, and updates about discounts on our titles. Don’t miss out—join the community and be the first to know about what’s coming next!

Mark your calendars and join us for a season of fun and celebration! ⛄

Stay tuned for more updates, and Merry Christmas in advance! 🎮❄️

The NyakuGames Team

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT FOR UPCOMING UPDATES
notes.content:
Did you think that for a game that cost so little the news was over?...
You probably don't know us enough!

[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]

2 Days ago we hit 1000 copies sold and that was a huge milestone... in the announcement we warned you that there would be a timeline full of updates for the game. And here we are announcing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109551/e4c2c4864c8a5fa947b6aa4daa00036cacb928e9.png[/img]

[b][h1]HALLOWEEN EVENT![/h1][/b]
What's better than a cute and sexy bat?
A [b]fully animated[/b] scene featuring our cute and charismatic shop girl is coming to you on October 31st!

Stay connected and ready not to miss it!

[b][h1]CHRISTMAS EVENT![/h1][/b]
Of course it doesn't end here... who doesn't like to celebrate Christmas?

Coming December 25th, a [b]fully animated[/b] Christmas-themed scene for our little shop friend!

Don't worry guys, we're not finished...

[b][h1]VALENTINE'S DAY EVENT[/h1][/b]
Some new dresses for the owner who kindly offered us to work in her cafe!

We think she deserves some love too, so we decided to add an additional scene!

Meanwhile don't forget to entertain her once you've finished all the quests in the game!
there's a little surprise when you complete all the objectives in the quest screen ;)

[b][h1]CONCLUSION[/h1][/b]

We thank you all for the support received and the positive reviews left about the game!

Happy Game!

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

Welcome back to this new patch notes!

We're continuing to receive some interesting feedback on how to improve the game that we agree with, so here's a new patch note!

[h1]Quality of life[/h1]

1) We noticed that the inconsistent drop rhythm in the minigame can cause frustration. And that memorizing the drop rhythm and focusing more on the milking animation could be more fun and enjoyable.

[b]now the drop will fall at a constant rate. to allow players to focus on the milking animation and memorize the rhythm of the drop's falling speed.[/b]


2) We've received feedback that timing the drop was too difficult. 

[b]so the alien ship will now have a more forgiving, easier-to-grab hitbox.[/b]


3) we realized that the minigame bar is a bit far from the milking animation, and this does not allow to observe the animation well.

[b]the minigame bar has been moved closer to the milking animation, so you don't have to look away too much[/b]

notes.title: Balance And Quality of Life
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

Welcome back to this new patch notes!
On the second day after the release we received new feedback about the game, and we decided to put some of them into practice!

[h1]balance[/h1]

1) Decreased the affection points needed for both girls' at intermediate affection levels, especially Haruka
2) Increased order spawn time

[h1]Quality of life[/h1]

Added the order board to the minigame screen as well to make it easier for players enjoying the minigame to avoid having to close and open the minigame screen

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

As always, we are available to answer any questions and actively monitor the community hub to answer your concerns.
Updates will continue to improve the game based on feedback as done in the following days.

GoodGame!

notes.content:
[h1]BUFF DELIVERY GIRLS[/h1]

We noticed that starting the delivery girls with full loads takes too long to receive the experience needed to unlock their photos.
Increases:
Increased the experience given to the first delivery girl from
[b]5 -> 10[/b]
Increased the experience given to the third delivery girl from
[b]5 -> 10[/b]
Increased the experience given to the fifth delivery girl from
[b]5 -> 20[/b]

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

if you have any suggestions or opinions regarding the game and the balance, don't hesitate to leave a comment, we will look at every single comment and do our best to improve the game!

Good Game!

notes.content:
[h1]Balance[/h1]

we noticed that progressing in the first and second level of the girls required too many clicks and the affection given by the gifts was not enough to progress linearly, so we decreased the affection required in the first levels. 

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
if you have any suggestions or opinions regarding the game and the balance, don't hesitate to leave a comment, we will look at every single comment and do our best to improve the game!

Good game!

notes.title: Minor Bug
notes.content:
[h1]Update Released: Purchase Text Display Issue Fixed[/h1]

We are pleased to announce that we have just released an update to fix a minor bug related to the display of text when purchasing machinery. In some cases, the text showing the costs and required resources was not being displayed correctly. This issue has now been resolved, and everything should function as expected.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and any issues this bug may have caused. We greatly appreciate your patience and continued support. If you encounter any further issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Announcement on the improvement and future of Cowgirl's Café!
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that with the release of Cowgirl's Café, we are committed to making the game the best it can be for you, our community!

[h1]We’re listening to our community! 📢[/h1]
Starting from launch day and throughout the following period, we will carefully read the reviews, community discussions, and comments under this post. Our main goal is to listen to your feedback to identify where we can improve the game, with a particular focus on balancing and the overall player experience.

[h1]Constant updates for game balance⚖️[/h1]
Thanks to your feedback, we will release constant updates to improve the game’s balance, making the experience as enjoyable and satisfying as possible. This means that as we receive feedback on how to improve challenges, progression, and game mechanics, we will ensure that the necessary changes are implemented quickly to keep the game balanced and fun.

[h1]Thematic events and new scenes coming soon 🎉[/h1]
In addition to improving and balancing the game based on your suggestions, we plan to organize thematic events that will introduce unique content. Furthermore, over time, we will add new scenes and gameplay situations, expanding the experience and keeping it fresh and exciting.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
Your support is crucial to us, and we can’t wait to build a more engaging experience together! Keep letting us know what you think, and stay tuned for future updates 🚀

Thank you all for your contributions, and we’ll see you at the café!

[i]The Cowgirl's Café development team[/i]
